subject.title: feat(codex): fork upstream-linked sessions at a message via thread/fork

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose the generic public `AgentHarness.sessionFork` and upstream-link write/delete contracts for harness-owned session forks, beginning with Codex app-server threads?
rationale: The implementation adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin SDK surface and persisted-session ownership behavior; code review can assess mechanics but cannot determine the intended long-term external plugin contract.

options.title: Approve the generic harness contract
options.body: Retain the new generic capability and SDK exports, subject to refreshed merge proof and real Codex app-server validation.

options.title: Keep this Codex-only for now
options.body: Avoid expanding the plugin SDK until a broader harness-fork contract and support expectations are agreed.

options.title: Defer upstream-linked session forks
options.body: Keep external-harness sessions unsupported until maintainers choose a durable cross-harness product model.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic harness contract
recommendation.body: Retain the new generic capability and SDK exports, subject to refreshed merge proof and real Codex app-server validation.
